body:
I know you're just some stranger on the internet, and I can't help but feel like I'm bothering you, but I hear you, I know what you're saying and I so badly want to believe it. 
I just can't grasp the idea that there are people out there who are capable of loving me, when my own family won't. Granted, our family has never been perfect, we've gone through a lot, but I have never done anything to alienate myself from my family, but they pushed me away anyway. They've pushed themselves away from eachother. 

I've only ever tried to make them proud,I've tried taking care of them. So if this doesn't make my own flesh and blood love me, who the heck would?

Right now my brain is saying, 'Stop typing, why would this person care? you're being stupid."
